proposals.evidence: Turner mahiṣa explicitly gives Nepali bhaĩsi, Hindi bhaĩsī/bhaĩsā and Oriya bhaĩs/bhaĩsā buffalo. The Tharu extended bhaisi-yā/bhaisan-iyā forms and Halbi bhõysa preserve that diagnostic bhais stem. This is a family-level comparison allowing local nominal extensions; their suffixes are not reconstructed as separate Sanskrit roots.

proposals.evidence: Turner āmra explicitly includes Nepali ā̃p, Gujarati/Marathi ā̃b/ā̃bā, Hindi ām and Sindhi āmī mango. These Terai, western and Haryana survey forms match the corresponding mango family, including the documented nasal-final ā̃p outcome. Compound answers and the distinct kairī family are excluded.
